profile.name: Gamry电化学工作站
profile.description: 一种用于电化学实验的台式电化学工作站（恒电位/恒电流仪），可施加设定的电位扫描并采集电流等响应信号，常用于循环伏安、线性扫描和电位斜坡类测试。
profile.description_en: A bench-top electrochemical workstation (potentiostat/galvanostat) used for electrochemical experiments. It applies programmed potential scans and records response signals such as current, commonly for cyclic voltammetry, linear sweep, and potential ramp measurements.
